about: Established in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection Limited is an Indian crop solutions company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of agrochemicals and hybrid seeds. Its offerings include herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, bio-stimulants, and seeds for field and vegetable crops. It operates manufacturing and seed processing units across India, supported by a pan-India network of over 14,700 distributors.

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment, in full or part, of certain borrowings availed by our Company
Investment in Material Subsidiary Saffire Crop Science for repayment/pre-payment of borrowings
Funding inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes

promoters.background: Nand Kishore Aggarwal is Founder and Chairman Emeritus with decades of agri-input experience. Ankur Aggarwal is Chairman and Managing Director, leading business strategy since 2006.

concentration.note: A significant portion of revenue is generated from domestic business via retail and distribution channels rather than single concentrated clients.

litigation_note: Outstanding legal proceedings involving the Company, Subsidiaries, Promoters, Directors, and SMPs aggregate to ₹341.95 crore (16.76% of Net Worth as of June 30, 2026), including DGFT cases of ₹75.53 crore.
strengths: Strong R&D capabilities backed by advanced technology infrastructure, 28 patents applied globally, and GLP-compliant KRDC facility.
Diversified portfolio across herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, bio-stimulants, and hybrid field and vegetable seeds.
Integrated business model spanning synthesis R&D, commercial formulation, seed processing, and pan-India distribution.
Wide pan-India distribution reach through 14,717 active distributors and 34 distribution centers across 23 states.
Established track record of successful inorganic acquisitions, integrating major brands such as Gramoxone, Bavistin, and Tilt.
Multi-generational leadership supported by experienced management and strong governance.

risks.title: Criminal and regulatory proceedings under DGFT
risks.detail: Company, Promoters, and Director face proceedings under DGFT involving ₹75.53 crore, representing 3.47% of Net Worth as of June 30, 2026.

risks.title: Material outstanding legal proceedings
risks.detail: Outstanding legal proceedings involving Company, Subsidiaries, Promoters, Directors, and SMPs aggregate to ₹341.95 crore (16.76% of Net Worth as of June 30, 2026).

risks.title: Vulnerability to climatic conditions and seasonal cyclicality
risks.detail: Adverse weather, pest attacks, or changes in cropping patterns may sharply reduce demand for agrochemicals and seeds.

risks.title: Domestic revenue concentration
risks.detail: Business is heavily dependent on domestic Indian agricultural demand; economic downturns in Indian farming could materially affect operations.

risks.title: Absence of long-term supply agreements
risks.detail: Company primarily sells via short-term purchase orders with distributors and customers without minimum volume commitments.

risks.title: Lengthy innovation cycles and regulatory scrutiny
risks.detail: Developing and registering new agrochemical solutions takes 5-7 years and involves stringent testing, carrying risk of technological obsolescence.

risks.title: Delays or failures in statutory and environmental approvals
risks.detail: Operations require multiple environmental clearances and renewals; pending approvals include consent renewals for Haryana and Maharashtra manufacturing units.

risks.title: Related party transactions
risks.detail: Company regularly engages in transactions with related parties, which may pose potential conflicts of interest.

notes: Restated consolidated financial statements used. Stub period for three months ended June 30, 2026 is ignored in multi-year arrays.
